title: Two assembly evidence locators point outside the retained UniProt batch
impact: The described native sequence evidence exists, but its two absolute pointers cannot be resolved against the exact cited body. This is a provenance locator defect, not an unsupported chemistry or protein identity conclusion.
acceptance: Preserve initial draft and finding bytes before correction.
Correct only the two sequence pointers (with any synchronized projected copies) to the exact batch entries.
Add meaningful locator guards that reject the old pointers and check entry accession plus actual sequence.
Reassess the exact changes independently; retain all seven native transformations and existing source/strain/endpoint limitations.
